## Highlights

- New: import an existing YouTube Music playlist straight from its link. A new "Import playlist" page (in the primary navigation, between Create and My playlists) fetches the playlist's tracks anonymously — no connected YouTube account required — and hands it off to the usual draft flow, so it can be reviewed, refined, saved and published exactly like a freshly generated playlist.

## New and improved

- Importing a playlist you already have in your local library is now blocked with a clear message pointing to the existing entry, instead of creating a duplicate.

## Fixes

- Hardened redaction of API keys in error messages so a custom/OpenAI-compatible provider's key can no longer leak back through an echoed provider error, beyond the already-covered major providers.
- Fixed MusicBrainz metadata lookups breaking when an artist, album or track name contains a double quote, which could distort the underlying search query.

## Upgrade notes

- No action required. Existing settings, favorites and playlist data carry over automatically.
